tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation strongly rejects the fitted static siphon model, but the evidence is not chaotic. The archive identifies a coupled memory ODE as a plausible alternative that needs at least eight rows; with only six observations, acquire the targeted fine-trajectory batch before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the two-layer static siphon directly
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The failed confirmation (RMSE 0.143, tolerance 0.045) refutes the proposed smooth static form; remaining notes include a coupled memory ODE requiring more trajectory rows.
Target H is short (0.6); the immediate identifiability problem is estimating the multi-parameter memory dynamics, for which a fine trajectory batch is the targeted probe.
Failure of one stationary model does not establish chaotic oscillations or refute all smooth mechanisms; informative trajectory data remain available.
Unrelated to the model discrimination and explicitly not useful.
